latestVersion.changelog:
miaoda-app-builder 1.0.11

- Improved instructions for when to call generate-app, aligning trigger with presence of Generate App button/action in the chat trajectory.
- list-apps: Added --brief flag to output only key fields for efficiency. Also added filters for name, page, and size.
- app-detail: Now auto-injects conversationId by default; added --no-context to disable this.
- Added get-context-id command to recover conversationId for existing apps, enabling modification after session resets.
- Updated documentation for better clarity on workflows, parameters, and usage examples.
